title: Thousands of AI Authors on the Future of AI
description: Selected task and probability thresholds from the 2023 survey of 2,778 AI researchers reported by Grace et al.

version.label: arXiv 2024 report of the 2023 survey
version.notes: Events are aggregate survey thresholds. They do not state that an outcome occurs on its calendar anchor.

attribution.organization: 2023 Expert Survey on Progress in AI
attribution.display: Grace et al. · 2023 Expert Survey on Progress in AI

milestones.title: 10% survey probability threshold for HLMI
milestones.summary: The aggregate survey distribution reaches a 10% probability of high-level machine intelligence by 2027.
milestones.source_context: Headline result: high-level machine intelligence timelines
milestones.normalization_rationale: The paper reports a year; July 1 is its representative midpoint.
milestones.uncertainty: HLMI is defined by the survey as unaided machines accomplishing every task better and more cheaply than human workers.

milestones.title: 10% survey probability threshold for full occupational automation
milestones.summary: The aggregate survey distribution reaches a 10% probability that all human occupations become fully automatable by 2037.
milestones.source_context: Headline result: full automation of labor
milestones.normalization_rationale: The paper reports a year; July 1 is its representative midpoint.
milestones.uncertainty: The paper distinguishes full occupational automation from its HLMI definition.

milestones.title: 50% survey probability threshold for HLMI
milestones.summary: The aggregate survey distribution reaches a 50% probability of high-level machine intelligence by 2047.
milestones.source_context: Headline result: high-level machine intelligence timelines
milestones.normalization_rationale: The paper reports a year; July 1 is its representative midpoint.
milestones.uncertainty: This is an aggregate survey probability, not a claim of certain arrival in 2047.

milestones.title: 50% survey probability threshold for full occupational automation
milestones.summary: The aggregate survey distribution reaches a 50% probability that all human occupations become fully automatable by 2116.
milestones.source_context: Headline result: full automation of labor
milestones.normalization_rationale: The paper reports a year; July 1 is its representative midpoint.
milestones.uncertainty: The very long tail and distinction from HLMI are material to interpreting this threshold.
